messages:
mike_support: FYI — BrightCart reported an incorrect tax on invoice INV-2026-078. They were charged NY state + NYC local tax (~8.875%) but their billing country is US and they're DE-incorporated with no NY nexus per customer. Can billing confirm how we picked jurisdiction?
anya_billing: Thanks Mike. Do we have the invoice payload / bill-to vs pay-method addresses? Also need customer's tax_exemption flag / resale cert if any.
devon_finance: If we billed NYC local incorrectly we'll need to issue a credit note and reissue invoice. Hold on refund until we confirm liability amount. Can someone paste the tax calc log?
sam_engineer: I pulled the tax calc for INV-2026-078. Log snippet: `tax_lookup: source=billing_address, country=US, region=NY, county=Kings, city=Brooklyn, tax_rate=0.08875, rules_applied=[state_sales, local_commuter]`
sam_engineer: Repro steps I used: 1) POST /invoices {"customer_id":"brightcart","bill_to":{"country":"US","region":"DE","postal_code":"19901"},"payment_method":{"billing_address":{"country":"US","region":"NY","postal_code":"11201"}} } 2) run tax/service/calc 3) observe county lookup picks `billing_address.region` if bill_to region empty.
anya_billing: ah — we expect tax jurisdiction to be determined from `bill_to` first, then payment billing_address. Looks like our API allowed an empty bill_to.region which triggered fallback to pm billing address. Customer said their legal address is DE (no nexus).
mike_support: Customer emailed receipts: they attached DE incorporation doc and said they don't have physical nexus in NY. They asked for corrected invoice + refund of the local tax they were charged.
devon_finance: Ok path: 1) issue credit note for local portion (~$162.40) 2) reissue invoice without county tax 3) refund or apply credit to card — recommend refund since they've already paid. Need sign-off from tax counsel? For now tag `legal-tax` and proceed with provisional credit.
sam_engineer: Quick fix: enforce `jurisdiction_source=bill_to` when present. I'll open ENG ticket to change fallback behavior and add a validation that bill_to.region required for US customers to avoid ambiguous jurisdiction.
payment-bot: PAYMENT LOG — invoice INV-2026-078 charged $1,829.40 on 2026-03-05 14:22 UTC, tax_component: state:$145.00 local:$162.40. Transaction ID tx_3K9bq.
anya_billing: Mike — can you ask customer to upload their DE registration & a short attestation? We'll attach to the credit note. Also need their preferred refund method (refund to card vs credit).
mike_support: Replied to customer asking for docs + refund preference. They prefer refund to card. Shared ETA: we'll process credit note once docs attached, provisional hold placed. :white_check_mark:
devon_finance: I'll prepare the credit note draft and flag for quick approval. Sam please link the ENG ticket and mark P0 for hotfix if fallback is causing overcharges.
sam_engineer: ENG-12345 created with reproducer and unit tests. I'll include the log & payload. Hoping for patch within 48h.
anya_billing: Noted. After credit/refund we'll update the invoice record and send corrected invoice PDF. I'll post final status here. :eyes:
